title: Project Engineer
lead: Join our Kuching team to monitor project progress, keep timelines on track and coordinate with clients, contractors and consultants to deliver our projects smoothly.

items.text: Minimum 1–2 years' experience in construction projects
Self-motivated, able to work independently and handle multiple tasks
Positive attitude with strong communication and interpersonal skills
Monitor project progress and ensure all documentation complies with relevant standards and regulations
Ensure project timelines and schedules are met
Coordinate and liaise with clients, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth project execution
5 working days (Monday – Friday, 8.00 AM to 5.00 PM)
Comprehensive health coverage, including annual health check-ups, medical and dental claims
